title: Wave VII — Memory & Persistence
scope: Memory lifecycle: read/write/verify consistency, rollback, backup invariants
topics: Memory write atomicity (write completes or not at all)
Memory read consistency (read returns last written value)
Directory traversal safety (no escape from workspace)
Backup consistency (if backup exists, it matches source)
proof_principle: Every proof proves what is already declared in the model. No new types, predicates, or invariants.
